en: The image is a multi-view postcard featuring several landmarks and scenic areas from Buziaș. The top left view shows a modernist building labeled 'PARC', likely a hotel or public facility, set among landscaped gardens. The top right has another large, modern building with balconies, possibly a hotel or sanatorium. The central strip vertically shows the name 'BUZIAȘ' in bold red letters. The middle left depicts a row of older, villa-style buildings on a tree-lined street. The middle right includes a white, stylized statue of a woman with arms raised, set in a garden. The bottom views depict lush public parks with walking paths, flower beds, and garden pavilions.
